proposal: IEC issues PER-001 Rev A with the EPC piping values as the expected case; guarantee corrections for piping pressure drop by curve.
question: PER-001 section 1 assumes HP 7.0 bar / 3 K, hot reheat 1.6 bar / 3 K, cold reheat 0.8 bar / 1 K, LP 0.45 bar / 2 K between HRSG and ST. The EPC HMB node balance shows these temperature drops imply 0.96 MW of piping heat loss; the EPC preliminary piping design (P91, 250 mm mineral wool) gives about 0.35 MW. EPC values: HP 5.5 bar / 1.5 K, HRH 1.4 bar / 1.5 K, CRH 0.7 bar / 1 K, LP 0.35 bar / 1 K. Please revise PER-001 with the EPC values or give the correction curves.
response: IEC agrees to use the EPC piping values as the expected case and will issue PER-001 Rev A. Guarantee correction for piping pressure drop: +1 bar HP = -0.10 MW, +0.1 bar hot reheat = -0.12 MW, +0.1 bar LP = -0.04 MW ST output.
subject: Steam piping pressure and temperature drop assumptions
